posts.description: Hello, Internet, and good mornight to you all. My name is Taffryne, shoppekeeper of Midnight on Memory Lane , and I am so sorry I went completely radio silent this past week . 'Twas not a pleasure, 'twas honestly quite awful indeed. To spare oversharing a painful memory's details, I unexpectedly had a really heartbreaking life event happen outside the shop's pocket dimension last Tuesday morning.
